ModMetaData.name: rimUIMCP
ModMetaData.author: JerryLunar (Hcrab); based on RimBridgeServer by Andreas Pardeike
ModMetaData.description:
让 AI 通过环世界的原生界面观察殖民地、安排工作和参与战斗。
rimUIMCP 为外部 AI 与脚本提供游戏状态读取、真实界面操作、暂停和按 tick 推进等能力。配套工具包含 MCP 入口、TypeScript / Python SDK、命令行和 28 个通用 helper。
安装：订阅本模组与 Harmony，并在模组列表中启用。Harmony 应在 rimUIMCP 前加载。AI 接入还需配套的本地运行时与客户端，使用方法见项目 README。当前版本面向 Windows / RimWorld 1.6。
Enable AI agents to observe your colony and play through RimWorld's native user interface.
rimUIMCP connects external agents and scripts to live game state, UI interactions, and pause / tick advancement. Companion tools include an MCP entry point, TypeScript and Python SDKs, a CLI, and 28 reusable helpers.
Subscribe to this mod and Harmony, then enable both with Harmony loaded first. Connecting an AI also requires the companion local runtime and client; see the project README for setup. This build targets Windows and RimWorld 1.6.
https://github.com/Hcrab/rimUIMCP
